C-GITHUB-THEME.IntentSummary: The GitHub theme family (github light + github-dark, GitHub Primer palettes) joins the 17-family theme model with full registration: theme CSS on the paper variable set, Prism companions with GitHub's own syntax colours, Primer role-colour --chartPalette, themeMap/themeCssFactories, railscasts dark classification for github-dark, command palette entries, native View › Theme menu items, the Settings Appearance tile and untranslated locale names in all ten locales — with the WCAG AA and pele node-contrast gates green.

MustPassCommand.Command: npx vitest run tests/renderer/util/theme-contrast.test.js tests/renderer/util/theme-families.test.js tests/renderer/util/theme.test.js tests/renderer/prefComponents/tabs-appearance.test.js tests/renderer/commands/menu-consistency.test.js tests/renderer/commands/index.test.js tests/renderer/muya/pele-node-contrast.test.js tests/renderer/release-materials.test.js

T-001.Title: Theme CSS pair on the paper variable set

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: github: Primer light (#FFFFFF ground, #1F2328 ink, #0969DA accent/links, #D1D9E0 hairlines, green #1F883D primary buttons, system UI font, h1/h2 README bottom rules); github-dark: Primer dark default (#0D1117/#F0F6FC/#4493F8/#3D444D/#238636). Both define the full paper variable set + a Primer role-colour --chartPalette; sidebar/tabs hairline chrome like docs.theme.css.

T-002.Title: Prism companions with GitHub syntax colours

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Light: #CF222E keywords, #0A3069 strings, #8250DF entities, #0550AE constants, #116329 tags on #F6F8FA; dark: #FF7B72/#A5D6FF/#D2A8FF/#79C0FF/#7EE787 on #151B23. Full token map like the docs companions; factory concatenation theme+prism.

themeColor.js (factories + themeCssFactories, v2.3.0), theme.js themeMap, themeFamilies.js 17th family (v1.2.0), config.js github-dark railscasts, commands/index.js two palette entries, m009_menu.rs two native View › Theme items, menu.theme.github/githubDark untranslated names in all ten locales + regenerated .min.json derivatives.

theme-contrast (EXPECTED 34, locale pins, GitHub registration describe with Primer colour pins), theme-families 17/34, tabs-appearance 17 tiles/34 halves, pele-node-contrast 34 with the Primer palettes passing the node gates; graph M-011 narrative + verification scenario-76-github-theme-family; renderer suite fully green.

C-1.Name: Variable parity and AA
C-1.Expected: Both themes define exactly the paper variable set; editorColor/linkColor ≥ 4.5:1 and blockquoteTextColor ≥ 3:1 on the editor background (theme-contrast gate green).

C-2.Name: Full registration
C-2.Expected: THEME_FAMILIES 17 (pairs 34), themeMap membership == family members, 34 palette subcommands, native menu lists GitHub/GitHub Dark, 10 locales carry github/githubDark, Appearance grid shows 17 tiles with real swatch colours.

C-3.Name: Dark classification
C-3.Expected: isDarkTheme('github-dark') true (railscasts → body.dark + dark CodeMirror), isDarkTheme('github') false.

C-4.Name: Chart palette
C-4.Expected: --chartPalette present in both; pele node-contrast gates pass for every node/border/label colour (34-theme gate green).

C-5.Name: Locale derivatives
C-5.Expected: Every *.min.json equals its source table after the key addition (release-materials MT_RELEASE_LOCALE_MIN_DRIFT gate green).

Correctness.Note: Found and fixed during bring-up: theme.test.js's themeColor mock lacked the new factories; pele-node-contrast pinned the shipped file set at 32; release-materials flagged locale/min drift until the derivatives were regenerated. All count pins updated (17/34) and the suite re-run green.

Security.Note: CSS-only addition; locales rewritten programmatically with 2-line diffs (formatting preserved); no new inputs, permissions or transports.

UX.Note: Family tile, palette entries and native menu reachable; github-dark rides the Auto resolution through the family model; system font + README h1/h2 rules mirror github.com.

Perf.Note: Two static ?inline CSS strings in the bundle; themeMap lookup unchanged.

Correctness.Note: Pixel-probed both themes in the built renderer: light {--editorBgColor #FFFFFF, h1 border-bottom rgb(209,217,224), table border #D1D9E0}, dark {body.dark, #0D1117, rgb(61,68,77)}; screenshots differ per theme; renderer suite green.
